obligations.text: A pull_request run is in a concurrency group of its pull request and cancels an older run in it; a push and a merge_group run each have a group of their own and cancel nothing.
code and every declared extra job need preflight; ci-gate needs preflight and the policy requires it on every event, so its failure, cancellation or skip blocks.
Every check preflight runs also runs in governance or code; a base gate.sh without the preflight verb makes the step pass and say so, and governance and code still judge everything.
On a pull_request whose base is not the default branch, preflight fails unless the pull request carries the label statecraft:stacked-ci; the label never changes governance's base refusal.
The code job restores the cargo cache on every event and saves it only on a push, which the workflow receives only for the default branch.
Spec 044's jobs are delivered as revision 19: wherever spec 044 names revision 18 it is read as revision 19, and revision 17 as revision 18.

Rendering and step tests show the concurrency group per event, the needs on preflight, preflight in the policy and in ci-gate, the stacked refusal and its label, the adoption pass, the cache split, and a revision-17 project upgrading in one plan.

sectionHeadings: 058: CI throughput: cancelled superseded runs, a preflight, and a default-branch cache
record.summary: Amends spec 002's setup profile. github-actions-rust revision 18 changes when work runs, never what judges it: a newer push to a pull request cancels that pull request's older run; a preflight job (the base, the committed artifacts' freshness, formatting) runs before code and every declared extra job, so a stacked pull request skips them unless it asks for them by label; and the code job restores the cargo cache on every event but saves it only from the default branch. Every check keeps running where it ran; ci-gate's rules are unchanged except that preflight is required.
record.title: Setup profile revision 18: superseded pull-request runs are cancelled, a preflight orders the expensive jobs, and the cargo cache is saved from the default branch only
